fields.label: “In this article” navigation
fields.instructions: A side panel listing the article’s H2 headings (a dropdown on phones). Off — one centred text column. Card photo — the Featured image. In the text: video — a YouTube link on its own line; slider — Add Media → Create gallery → “Display as: Slider”; a box with a button — the megaphone button in the toolbar.
